court: In the High Court of Madras
respondents: State rep by The Inspector Of Police, Mangadu Police Station … Respondent(s).
advocates: For Respondent(s): Ms. J.R. Archana, G.A(Crl. Side)
prayer: Prayer: This appeal has been filed seeking to set aside the conviction and sentence imposed vide judgment dated 10-5-2023 made in SC.(k) No. 18 of 2011 on the file of Sessions Judge, Mahila Court, Chengalpattu.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

A.D. Jagadish Chandira, J.:— The criminal appeal is partly allowed and the conviction and sentence imposed on the appellant/accused, viz, Dhayalan, S/o. Singaram by the learned Sessions Judge, Mahila Court, Chengalpet, in SC (K). No. 18 of 2011 by judgment dated 10-5-2023 for the offences under Sections 366, 376 r/w 511, 341 & 307 IPC are hereby set aside and in the alternative, the accused is found guilty for the offence under Sections 323 and 341 IPC and convicted and sentenced to undergo 1 year simple imprisonment for the offence under Section 323 IPC, and 3 months simple imprisonment for the offence under Section 341 IPC and the sentences shall run concurrently.

2. Since the appellant/accused has already undergone incarceration for a period of 6 years 9 months and 23 days, the maximum sentence for the offence under Sections 323 & 341 IPC being one year, the appellant/accused is directed to be set at liberty forthwith, unless his presence is required in connection with any other case.
